lessons.title: Hello! (Unit 1)
lessons.content: Greeting people and saying your name: hello, hi, goodbye, bye, good morning, good afternoon. What's your name? My name's Tala.

questions.questionText: What do you say when you meet your teacher in the morning?

Complete: My ___ is Omar.

Put the words in order: name's / My / Tala
Hello
Good morning
Goodbye
Hello, my name's Tala

lessons.content: Food words: nut, olive, melon, date, egg, bread, cheese. Counting 1, 2, 3.

Bread

lessons.content: Animal words: insect, goat, rabbit, cat, kitten, lion, zebra, dog. Counting 4, 5, 6.

Cat

lessons.content: Body words: head, hand, finger, leg, face, nose, mouth. Counting 7, 8, 9, 10.

lessons.content: Family words: Mum, Dad, sister, brother, baby, me. Who's this? This is my brother.
